title: Inside ota/sdk
caption: Public modules mirror the contract files one to one; each namespace method is one line through the generated route table; the request core, the session and the transport do the work. Scripts generate the table and build the bundles. Click a node for its file.

nodes.label: index.js
nodes.detail: `createVelexisClient`, `VERSION`, re-exports; `clientOf(core)` builds the eight namespaces, `withOptions` and `request`.

nodes.label: shared.js
nodes.detail: `VelexisError` and its 13 subclasses, `isVelexisError`, `Page`, `VelexisClientOptions`, `RequestOptions`; `toJSON()` redaction of keys, tokens and JWTs.

nodes.label: identity.js, flights.js, bookings.js, console.js
nodes.detail: Typedefs that mirror the contract `.d.ts` files, and the factories `createStorefrontApi` … `createConsoleApi`.

nodes.label: storefront, reference, flights, checkout, bookings, auth, account, console
nodes.detail: One factory per namespace. Special logic: auth (strip tokens in cookie mode, adopt session results), checkout (airline-card error scrubbing), bookings/account/console (`requireIfMatch`), console (multipart upload, `originSystemCode: "GDS"` default).

nodes.label: client.js
nodes.detail: Option validation (`TypeError` naming the option, never its value), mode choice, `core.call` (path/query/header/body split), `core.request` (escape hatch), `derive` for `withOptions`.

nodes.label: session.js
nodes.detail: Credentials per mode, CSRF copy and re-fetch, the automatic refresh, the client family (`createFamily`: `refreshing`, `replaced` with 512 tokens, 10 s `ROTATION_WINDOW_MS`), `adopt` of session results.

nodes.label: http.js
nodes.detail: Headers, `fetch`, timeout per attempt (body included), retries on 429/503/504/network errors with back-off 0.5 s → 8 s ± 20 %, `Retry-After` (> 30 s ends the call), `onResponse`.

nodes.label: errors.js
nodes.detail: `errorClassFor(status, code)`, fallback codes for responses without the envelope, `parseRetryAfter`, `connectionError` (status 0).

nodes.label: pagination.js
nodes.detail: `Page<T>`: `data`, `page.nextCursor`, `next()`, `for await`; extra fields (`total`, `facets`, `snapshot` …) copied onto the page.

nodes.label: operations.js (GENERATED)
nodes.detail: 129 frozen entries keyed `namespace_method`: method, path, path/query/header params, idempotency, retry class, timeout, environment flag, body kind. Never edited by hand.

nodes.label: generate-operations.mjs + operation-overrides.json
nodes.detail: Reads the OpenAPI document, applies reviewed timeouts and `retry: never`, writes `operations.js` and `test/contract/methods.generated.ts`. CI fails on a diff.

nodes.label: build.mjs + check-size.mjs
nodes.detail: esbuild ESM + IIFE, `tsc` declarations, copy of the OTA API types; fails above 25 KB min+gzip (1.0.0: 15.8 KB).

nodes.label: dist/types/*.d.ts
nodes.detail: One per module plus `api-types.d.ts`; self-contained (no `@velexis/api-types` import).
